summary.name: 有道写作 (Youdao Writing)
summary.one_liner: An English writing assistant from NetEase Youdao that checks and polishes English essays, including photos of handwritten work, aimed at Chinese learners.
use_cases: Correcting English essays for school or exams
Preparing IELTS or TOEFL writing practice
Uploading photos of handwritten English compositions for correction
Polishing English sentences to sound more native
Finding example sentences and better word choices while writing
summary.what_it_does: The tool reviews English writing for accuracy (grammar, spelling, format, coherence), language style, vocabulary variety and clarity. It offers native-style sentence polishing and bilingual Chinese-English writing support. Handwritten essays can be photographed and converted to text for correction, and it links with the Youdao Dictionary app for word lookup and example sentences. Writing types covered include primary to high school, CET-4/6, postgraduate entrance, IELTS, TOEFL and academic papers.
notable: Photo upload of handwritten English essays with image-to-text correction
Correction system tuned to English writing habits of Chinese learners
Covers exam writing types from primary school through IELTS, TOEFL and academic papers
Integrated with Youdao Dictionary mobile app and PC client
caveats: Web version works only in desktop browsers; Google Chrome recommended
Pricing details are not stated on the page
